$comment: The labels this repository uses. Checked in so repo:check can hold every --label in a workflow, and every labels: in an issue template, to a name that exists. It could not before: the canary opened its provider-drift issue with --label flag:provider-drift, that label had never been created, gh resolves labels server-side and errors, and || echo turned the error into a warning on an already-green run. The alarm could not ring for eleven weeks. This file is the offline half; GitHub is still the authority, and nothing here proves the two agree.
